title: Registres i pesos a Constantí
lang: ca
ref: figura-constanti-pesos
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/punts-escenaris.json, context/inputs/constanti-ortofoto-2025.png]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/constanti-pesos.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/punts-escenaris.json').read_text())
c=next(x for x in d['municipalities'] if x['code']==430477)
xy=np.array([p['xy'] for p in c['points']])/1000
w=np.array([p['weights'][1] for p in c['points']]);assigned=np.array([p['published'] is None for p in c['points']])
r=np.array(c['mean'])/1000;p=np.array(c['scenarios']['w_mid']['centre'])/1000
a,b,e,n=np.array(d['basemap']['bounds'])/1000
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'constanti-pesos'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,6.4),layout='constrained')
image=plt.imread(root/'context/inputs/constanti-ortofoto-2025.png')
for ax in axes:
    ax.imshow(image,extent=[a,e,b,n],alpha=.48)
    ax.set(xlim=(a,e),ylim=(b,n),aspect='equal',xlabel='Est UTM (km)')
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(3));ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(3));ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False,style='plain')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Nord UTM (km)')
axes[0].scatter(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],s=22,color='#006699',edgecolors='white',linewidths=.3)
axes[0].scatter(*r,s=150,marker='D',color='#b22d43',edgecolors='white',zorder=6)
axes[0].annotate('Centre dels registres',r,xytext=(344.2,4554.8),fontsize=16,color='#b22d43',
    arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#b22d43'},bbox={'facecolor':'white','alpha':.94,'edgecolor':'none','pad':2})
axes[0].set_title('Cada registre compta una vegada\n124 punts',fontsize=18,pad=12)
for mask,color in [(~assigned,'#006699'),(assigned,'#e69f00')]:
    axes[1].scatter(xy[mask,0],xy[mask,1],s=1.5*w[mask],facecolors=color,edgecolors='#333333',linewidths=.45,alpha=.85)
axes[1].plot([r[0],p[0]],[r[1],p[1]],color='#b22d43',ls='--',lw=2,zorder=5)
axes[1].scatter(*r,s=150,marker='D',color='#b22d43',edgecolors='white',zorder=6)
axes[1].scatter(*p,s=260,marker='*',color='#111111',edgecolors='white',zorder=7)
for text,at,target in [('Centre dels registres',r,(350.1,4555.5)),('Centre ponderat',p,(344.2,4556.0))]:
    axes[1].annotate(text,at,xytext=target,fontsize=16,arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#333333'},
        bbox={'facecolor':'white','alpha':.94,'edgecolor':'none','pad':2})
imax=int(np.argmax(w));assert c['points'][imax]['published']==450
axes[1].annotate('450 kW publicats',xy[imax],xytext=(343.9,4562.3),fontsize=18,
    arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#333333'},bbox={'facecolor':'white','alpha':.94,'edgecolor':'none','pad':2})
axes[1].set_title('Àrees proporcionals als pesos\n2.770 kW publicats + 200 assignats',fontsize=18,pad=12)
fig.legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='D',ls='',color='#b22d43',label='Centre dels registres'),
    Line2D([],[],marker='*',ls='',color='#111111',markersize=14,label='Centre ponderat'),
    Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color='#006699',label='Valor publicat'),
    Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color='#e69f00',label='Valor assignat')],
    loc='outside lower center',ncol=2,frameon=False,fontsize=17)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/constanti-pesos.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
